verdict.rationale: Kick's own MCP server lets an AI agent execute bookkeeping changes 'with your approval', and Kick runs a real double-entry ledger. However, the docs never say an agent can draft or post manual journal entries through the API, and the only review gate shown is in-chat approval by the user, not a queue an accountant works from; no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented journal-entry create/post endpoint or MCP tool, draft/pending status for agent-created entries, accountant-facing review queue, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent draft and post journal entries via the API and leave them in a review queue for my accountant

citations.quote: Your AI can query transactions, generate reports, and update bookkeeping — all with your approval.
Query transactions, generate reports, create automation rules, and execute bookkeeping changes
A journal entry is a double-entry record with two sides: a debit and a credit.
